categories.main_business_segments: Yamatane Corporation operates four main business segments: logistics (including warehousing, port transportation, and freight forwarding), food (rice wholesaling, rice milling, and processed/frozen food wholesale), information (IT system development, maintenance, and inventory-related services), and real estate (property sales, leasing, and management). The group structure includes several wholly owned subsidiaries specializing in these areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced logistics management, warehousing, and supply chain optimization, including cold chain and SCM solutions. In food, it utilizes modern rice milling and quality control systems, with a focus on traceability and environmental sustainability. The information segment provides system integration, DX support, and inventory management solutions, while real estate operations emphasize property value enhancement and CRE strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major players in the food, retail, restaurant, and essential goods sectors, as well as manufacturers and medical industries. The food segment serves large retailers, food service chains, and specialty rice shops, while logistics supports a broad range of industries requiring storage and distribution. The information segment targets both internal group companies and external clients needing IT and inventory solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Japan, with a strong presence in the Tokyo metropolitan area and major ports such as Keihin and Kobe. The company also has logistics and food processing facilities in Chiba and Niigata, and is expanding its reach in western Japan through recent acquisitions. International logistics services include overseas forwarding and relocation support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yamatane operates across the midstream and downstream supply chain, acting as a logistics integrator, rice wholesaler, and processed food distributor. It also provides upstream support through direct involvement in agricultural production and supply chain optimization, and downstream through retail and food service channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing group synergies, expanding the value chain in food and logistics, and advancing digital transformation (DX) across operations. The company emphasizes sustainability (GHG reduction, diversity, and community engagement), supply chain innovation, and workforce development. R&D is not a major focus, but investment in automation, AI-driven agriculture, and IT system upgrades is ongoing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees for warehousing, logistics, and transportation, as well as product sales from rice and processed foods. The information segment earns from system integration, software development, and equipment rental, while the real estate segment generates income from property leasing and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yamatane competes with major Japanese logistics providers, food wholesalers, and real estate firms. It differentiates itself through integrated logistics and food supply chain solutions, a strong presence in rice distribution, and a focus on high-quality, sustainable operations. The company is a mid-sized player with a niche in food logistics and value-added services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated revenue reached 80.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 3.78 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.09 billion yen. The company has shown strong growth, particularly in the food segment (boosted by M&A), and maintains a solid asset base (167 billion yen in total assets). The workforce exceeds 1,000 employees, and the company is targeting further revenue and profit growth through its 2028 mid-term plan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yamatane emphasizes integrated logistics and food supply chain solutions, high-quality and safe food products, and advanced IT-driven services. Its unique value lies in combining logistics expertise with food industry knowledge, sustainability initiatives, and a commitment to customer satisfaction and operational excellence. The company also highlights its ability to adapt to market changes and support sustainable agriculture and community development.
